Add Text

Each one adds a new text box to your stage. Choose its font below.

Fonts

Select a text element, then choose a font. Size, weight, colour, alignment, direction and effects are in Edit.

Text Effects

Select a text element, then choose an effect. Fine-tune it under Text Effects in Properties.

My Fonts

0/3

Fonts you uploaded. Select a text element, then choose one.

Upload My Font

WOFF2, TTF or OTF, up to 3 fonts. TTF and OTF (up to 8 MB) become WOFF2, stored up to 2 MB. Counts toward your storage; private unless your published Wall uses it.

Media & Links

Supported platforms

Tap a platform to see what you can paste and how it can show: Player plays on your Wall, Card, Link and Icon (its logo) open it on the platform. Icon Group puts several icons in one element.

A pasted link is Wall content. Your connected accounts (identity) are managed in your GamID under My connections.

Shapes

Fill, gradient, border, corner radius and opacity are in Edit once a shape is selected.

Background

GamID blocks

Your Classic GamID profile, live on your Wall: each piece always shows your current data, never a copy. Visitors only see what your GamID shows publicly.

Real data from your GamID, never sample content. Private information stays private: blocks show only what your GamID already allows to be shown.

GamID data

One live piece of your GamID, placed and styled anywhere: it always shows your current data, never a copy. Visitors only see what your GamID shows publicly.

Layers (top first)

Stages are in the Stages bar above the editor. To move elements to another stage, select them and use Move to stage at the top of Properties.

    Assets

    Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF (GIFs stay animated), up to 5 MB each. Videos: MP4 (H.264) or WebM (VP8 / VP9 - keeps transparency), up to 50 MB; they play muted and on a loop. Your uploads are private to you.

      Canvas: pinch with two fingers on empty canvas to zoom, drag empty canvas to pan. Touch an element to select and drag it; two fingers on a selected element resize it. Zoom only changes your view, never the Wall.
